items.headline: Anthropic opens its Cyber Verification Program to more defenders
items.summary: Anthropic merged its Cyber Verification Program with Project Glasswing and split access into three tiers (Defense, Red Team, Specialized). Vetted security teams, including smaller firms, open-source maintainers and some individual researchers, get fewer blocking filters on Claude's most capable models.
items.why_it_matters: If you or your web developer do any security work, Claude will refuse less often once verified. For everyone else it shows how Anthropic decides who gets the most powerful tools.

items.headline: GPT-6 rolls out in ChatGPT with a new "Intelligent UI"
items.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT, with answers that can include visuals and interactive elements. Reports say the GPT-6 Sol model goes to paid subscribers and the lighter GPT-6 Luna to Free and Go users.
items.why_it_matters: If you use free ChatGPT, you should see a noticeable upgrade without paying. It is also a good moment to compare it side by side with Claude on your own everyday tasks.
